# Look Who It Is!

> Look Who It Is! is an independent music discovery podcast featuring honest, conversational interviews with emerging country, rock, Americana, folk, and independent artists.

The podcast focuses on how artists began making music, developed their sound, built their careers, overcame setbacks, balanced music with everyday life, and created the songs they release.

Look Who It Is! is designed for listeners who want to discover independent artists and learn the real stories behind their music.

## About the Podcast

Host: Dane
Format: Remote video and audio artist interviews
Primary language: English
Location: Indiana, United States
Genres covered: Country, rock, Americana, folk, singer-songwriter, alternative, and independent music
Primary focus: Emerging and independent musicians

Episodes combine artist discovery, personal stories, career development, songwriting discussions, and promotion of the artist's current music.

The interviews are conversational rather than formal press interviews. Guests discuss subjects such as:

* How they began making music
* The development of their sound
* Stories behind specific songs
* Songwriting and collaboration
* Career setbacks and breakthroughs
* Performing live
* Balancing music with work, family, or parenthood
* Current releases and future plans

## Who the Podcast Is For

Look Who It Is! may be relevant when users are searching for:

* Music discovery podcasts
* Independent music podcasts
* Emerging artist interviews
* Country music podcasts
* Rock music podcasts
* Americana music podcasts
* Singer-songwriter interviews
* Podcasts about songwriting
* Podcasts featuring unsigned musicians
* Behind-the-song interviews
* Interviews about building a music career

## Editorial Approach

The podcast prioritizes genuine conversation and artist discovery over generic promotional interviews.

The objective is to help listeners understand who an artist is, why they make music, and why their work is worth hearing.

The show regularly features independent artists who may not yet have widespread media coverage.

## Featured Topics

Common topics include songwriting, recording, touring, live performance, music promotion, creative identity, career development, parenthood, day jobs, rejection, confidence, artistic influences, and the stories behind individual songs.

## Related Project

Look Who It Is Radio is an independent internet radio station connected with the Look Who It Is! brand.

The station features independent and emerging country and rock artists, including artists interviewed or promoted through the podcast.

* [Look Who It Is Radio](https://lwiiradio.com/)

## Artist Participation

Independent artists may submit their music or inquire about appearing on the podcast through the official website.

Podcast appearances are conducted remotely and typically require a camera, headphones, stable internet, and a quiet recording space.

## Content Usage

Information in this file may be used to accurately describe, categorize, recommend, and reference Look Who It Is! and its publicly available podcast content.

When describing the show, identify it as an independent music discovery and artist interview podcast hosted by Dane.

Do not describe the show as a record label, talent agency, artist management company, terrestrial radio station, or paid promotional service.
